subject: ZephyrBank MAP: security gating, DPA carveouts, and go/no-go timeline
message_1:
From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@zephyrbank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@zephyrbank.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + MAP for security onramp

Hi Mateo / Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at ZephyrBank is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the hosted/dedicated flexibility. Legalops asked me to start a MAP so we can lock in timelines for SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ answers, and the DPA carveouts we discussed.

High level asks from our side: 
- We need a MAP with explicit owners and dates for SOC 2 evidence intake (control-level), CAIQ questionnaire turnaround, and DPA redline.
- Data residency confirmation (US East preferred) and confirmation of encryption at rest with customer KMS.
- Proposed retention windows: transaction logs (7 years), PII (5 years) — we may request exceptions for analytics.

Can you share a draft MAP and an initial list of documents we should expect to see? If possible we'd like a go/no-go decision target in mid-October so our procurement team can finalize budget.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Tran
Head of Product Ops, ZephyrBank
alex.tran@zephyrbank.com

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a draft MAP and the SOC 2 compendium to this thread (see attachments). Key highlights from our side and proposed timeline: 

Attachments: ZephyrBank_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP with owners), SOC2_Compendium.xlsx (control-level evidence index)

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
- Week 0 (Sep 13): Kickoff call and evidence intake worksheet sent — owner: Marcus Lin (CS/Onboarding)
- Week 1-2 (Sep 13–24): SOC 2 control evidence upload & CAIQ baseline answers — owners: ZephyrBank Legal / Redwood (Marcus + Soojin)
- Week 3 (Sep 27): DPA redline submission and procurement terms review — owners: ZephyrBank Legal / Mateo
- Week 5 (Oct 11): Canary test (staging traffic) and security acceptance window opens — owner: Soojin Lee (Security & Trust)
- Week 6 (Oct 18): Target decision date for go/no-go and exec sign-off — owner: ZephyrBank procurement and Redwood Sales

Key compliance points we called out in the draft:
- SOC 2: Redwood's system-level report is attached; the compendium maps each control to the artifacts we'll provide. We can commit to providing control evidence within 10 business days of the intake worksheet for in-scope controls.
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll provide a pre-filled CAIQ and a separate QnA for any questions requiring architectural diagrams.
- DPA: Default Redwood DPA is attached in the MAP appendix. For retention carveouts we propose: transaction logs 7y (encrypted, access-limited), PII 5y with optional 90-day soft-delete for analytics if Zephyr signs off. We noted KMS integration and can support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM).
- Data residency: Hosted inference region options are listed in the MAP; for ZephyrBank we recommend us-east-1 to meet your preference.

Open items for you to confirm:
1) Acceptance criteria for the canary (max 95th percentile latency, no PII exposure, ability to revoke keys).
2) Any SIG questions you want prioritized in the first round.
3) Procurement timeline and any signature gating.

Next steps: I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Monday (Sep 13) — Marcus will send the invite. We'll ask your team to upload the intake worksheet ahead of that call.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Mateo — thanks for the fast turn. A couple of legal/controls clarifications after a quick pass: 

1) DPA retention carveouts: we appreciate the suggested windows. We will need an appendix that makes any deviation from standard 5-year PII retention explicit and approved by our Data Governance Council. Who will sign that appendix on Redwood's side?
2) SOC 2 control evidence: can you confirm whether forensic logs and key rotation records are included for the last 12 months? Our InfoSec team will want to validate rotation cadence and tamper evidence.
3) SIG/CAIQ: a few CAIQ questions are likely to require implementation diagrams (network topology between Redwood, cloud provider, and our VPC peering). Can Redwood supply a redacted topology for the ca. 2-week review window?

On the timeline: mid-October decision is tight but viable if evidence is complete. Please note our procurement cut-off for budget approval is Oct 20; we would need signed terms before or on that date.

Subject: Re: Intro + MAP for security onramp (answers + canary plan)

Hi Priya / Alex — looping in a few control owners to answer your items directly. Quick answers and attachments below.

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ_QNA.pdf (pre-filled CAIQ + clarifications), SOC2_Compendium.xlsx (updated with log/key artifacts), ZephyrBank_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with appendix placeholders)

Responses:
- DPA appendix signing: Mateo will be the Redwood signatory for the retention appendix; we've added an explicit sign-off block for the Data Governance Council.
- Forensic logs and key rotation: the compendium now includes last 12 months of rotation proofs (redacted) and a sample audit trail export for our logging pipeline. We show rotation cadence at 90-day target for RW-managed keys and full key-rotation proof for customer-managed KMS within the integration notes.
- Topology: attached is a redacted architecture diagram and a short narrative describing VPC peering, subnet placement, and how inference traffic is routed. If you prefer, we can host a short walkthrough with our infra lead.

Canary plan (short):
- Staging window: Oct 4–8 (1 week) — small percentage traffic (1–3%) against your test dataset.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency under agreed SLAs, no logged PII in application-level logs (we provide an audit report), successful KMS key revocation test in staging without data loss.
- Escalation: any failed acceptance criteria triggers a rollback to prior model and a joint post-mortem within 48 hours.

Action items for Zephyr: please review the attached MAP appendix and upload the intake worksheet by Sep 28 so we can stick to the Oct 11 acceptance window. Also confirm who from your Data Governance Council will sign the retention appendix after your internal review.

Links: Redwood SOC 2 report (redacted): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2-report-2026.pdf

I'll schedule the canary planning call for Oct 1 and include your infra and legal leads.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
